message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI - @nwutils/packager

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "packages/packager/**"
      - "tests/fixtures/packager/**"
      - "tests/specs/packager/**"
      - "tests/fixtures/deeplink/**"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-packager-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - macos-26
          - macos-26-intel
          - ubuntu-24.04
          - ubuntu-24.04-arm
          - windows-2025
          - windows-11-arm
        include:
          - os: macos-26
            display: MacOS 26 ARM
            format: dmg
          - os: macos-26-intel
            display: MacOS 26 Intel
            format: dmg
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            display: Ubuntu 24.04 Intel
            format: appimage
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            display: Ubuntu 24.04 ARM
            format: appimage
          - os: windows-2025
            display: Windows 11 Intel
            format: nsis
          - os: windows-11-arm
            display: Windows 11 (ARM)
            format: nsis
      fail-fast: false
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: ${{ matrix.display }}
    if: github.repository_owner == 'nwutils'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - name: Check git status is clean after checkout
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "::error::Working tree is dirty immediately after checkout. This usually means a line-ending or .gitattributes normalization mismatch on this runner."
            git status
            git diff
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Read Node.js and npm versions from devEngines
        id: devengines
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "NODE_VERSION=$(jq -r '.devEngines.runtime.version' package.json)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "NPM_VERSION=$(jq -r '.devEngines.packageManager.version' package.json)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Update npm to the pinned version
        run: npm install -g npm@${{ env.NPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Install third party dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install NSIS on Windows
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if ! command -v makensis; then
            choco install nsis --no-progress -y
            echo "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\NSIS" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          fi

      # Each OS only tests the format it packages: AppImage on Linux, DMG on MacOS, NSIS on Windows.
      - name: Run packager ${{ matrix.format }} test suites
        run: npm run test:${{ matrix.format }} --workspace=@nwutils/packager

      - name: Run packager platform independent test suites
        run: npm run test:common --workspace=@nwutils/packager

      - name: Check git status is clean
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "::error::Working tree is dirty after install/test. A generated file was likely committed that should be gitignored, or a script mutated tracked files. Run 'git status' locally after these steps to see what changed."
            git status
            git diff
            exit 1
          fi",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `npm ci` on every job across a six-OS matrix, but `actions/setup-node` does not enable the npm dependency cache, so dependencies are re-fetched on every run. The repository has a committed `package-lock.json`, satisfying the cache-input precondition for P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency cache). Adding `cache: npm` caches the npm cache keyed on the lockfile, preserving every install/test step and required check while reducing repeated dependency fetch time. No permissions are weakened, no new network access or secrets are added, and no build/test coverage is removed.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
